en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional-sounding dance song. Forms like фанаја/фанаа are dialect past tenses of 'to take hold'; лидо I read as 'sweetheart', somewhat unsure.

lines.cyr: Бате Петре засвири, засвири со гајдата,
lines.lat: Bate Petre zasviri, zasviri so gajdata,
lines.en: Brother Petre, play, play on the bagpipe,

lines.cyr: бате Петре засвири, засвири со гајдата,
lines.lat: bate Petre zasviri, zasviri so gajdata,
lines.en: brother Petre, play, play on the bagpipe,

lines.cyr: дај-ду-ру-ду-лу ли-ди-лид, засвири со гајдата.
lines.lat: daj-du-ru-du-lu li-di-lid, zasviri so gajdata.
lines.en: daj-du-ru-du-lu li-di-lid, play on the bagpipe.

lines.cyr: Еј, еј, бате Петре гајдаџи, засвири со гајдата,
lines.lat: Ej, ej, bate Petre gajdadži, zasviri so gajdata,
lines.en: Hey, hey, brother Petre the piper, play on the bagpipe,

lines.cyr: бате Петре засвири, оро да заиграме.
lines.lat: bate Petre zasviri, oro da zaigrame.
lines.en: brother Petre, play, so we can dance the oro.

lines.cyr: Цело село станало, на оро се фанало,
lines.lat: Celo selo stanalo, na oro se fanalo,
lines.en: The whole village got up, joined hands in the oro,
